python_igraph.note: python-igraph 0.11.9 does not expose community_voronoi; the upstream C function exists (igraph_community_voronoi) but is not bound at the Python layer in this version. No cross-language timing baseline captured. R's rigraph also lacks the binding.

notes: Fixed-r runs a single LRD generator-picking pass plus one inner voronoi() assignment; auto-r wraps the same in a Brent quadratic-fit optimizer (up to ~25 iterations, observed ~3x slowdown on karate).

karate-fixed-r1 mirrors the deterministic portion of references/igraph/tests/unit/igraph_community_voronoi.c. The LRD greedy step does O(n) Dijkstra/BFS work proportional to the picked-generator count.

grid-fixed-r1 (20x20 = 400v, 760 edges, weights = 1.0 + i mod 5) exercises the weighted Dijkstra LRD path; ~540 us reflects ~1.3 us per vertex, dominated by the binary-heap operations in the inner voronoi() call.
Auto-r is intentionally not benched on the grid: the outer Brent loop multiplies the per-call cost by ~25 with no algorithmic insight beyond what the karate auto-r number already shows.
